text:
jordan-cs: FYI ACME is seeing a sudden spike of 429s from their Dedicated pool starting ~08:12 UTC. Customer says nothing changed on their side.
amelia-support: thanks, can you paste a sample request/response and the tenant id? we'll escalate if it's quota related.
jordan-cs: tenant=acme-enterprise-3
jordan-cs: curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer <redacted>" -d '{"input":"hello"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
jordan-cs: response headers: HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
X-RateLimit-Limit: 1200
X-RateLimit-Remaining: 0
X-RateLimit-Reset: 1700000000
body: {"error":"rate_limit_exceeded","code":429}

opsbot: Incident created: INC-2026-1183 (autolabel: dedicated-quota)
elena-sre: looking at the dedicated pool metrics now. I see a drop in autoscaler tokens at 08:10 and concurrent requests for acme jumped from 10->420 in 2m.
raj-platform: pulling quota config for tenant acme-enterprise-3
raj-platform: sql: SELECT tenant_id, scope, unit, window_seconds, burst_tokens FROM tenant_quotas WHERE tenant_id='acme-enterprise-3' /* returned row */
raj-platform: tenant_id=acme-enterprise-3, scope=project, unit=tokens, window_seconds=60, burst_tokens=100
amelia-support: window_seconds=60? that seems suspicious — we usually store windows in seconds but migrations convert hours->seconds.
jordan-cs: customer migration ran last night (plan change). could this be a migration bug that turned hours into minutes?
elena-sre: confirmed: history shows a config rollout at 03:22 with payload that changed unit from "tokens_per_hour" to internal numeric window_seconds=60 for several enterprise tenants. That will enforce per-minute instead of per-hour.
amelia-support: explain impact in plain terms for customer: their allowance was 1200 tokens/hour. with window_seconds=60 we now only allow ~20 tokens/minute -> burst exhausted -> 429s.
opsbot: Pager suppression enabled for INC-2026-1183 (quiet window)
raj-platform: quick mitigation: bump tenant quota and roll back migration flag for acme-enterprise-3. Running: UPDATE tenant_quotas SET window_seconds=3600 WHERE tenant_id='acme-enterprise-3';
raj-platform: rollback applied, cache invalidation issued to quota-service
elena-sre: observing drop in 429s in logs. error rate from acme down from 35% -> 1.2% over last 4m.
jordan-cs: relaying to customer: they confirm errors stopped. thanks team.
amelia-support: next actions: 1) full sweep for other tenants where migration set window_seconds=60 incorrectly 2) add migration dry-run and unit test 3) backfill correct windows and notify impacted customers 4) postmortem + CAB note
raj-platform: opened PR to add safety check (reject window_seconds < 300 unless opt-in). tagging eng-release for hotfix.
elena-sre: add monitoring alert for unusual mismatch between declared unit (tokens_per_hour) and stored window_seconds to catch this earlier.
opsbot: INC-2026-1183 updated: status=mitigated, assignees=[raj-platform, elena-sre, amelia-support]
customer-alerts-bot: Customer ACME: We observed a brief service disruption due to quota conversion issue. Root cause identified and fixed. Follow-up email queued.
amelia-support: closing thread here, will write up PM and add to postmortems channel later. :white_check_mark:
